verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud documents 'Sift' as a tool to 'run automated investigations... and surface likely causes,' directly matching the story of AI investigating alerts and proposing root causes, and separately offers natural-language querying and an MCP server for AI agent integration. However, evidence is limited to brief marketing/doc snippets with no detailed workflow description or independent/hands-on validation of Sift's root-cause accuracy. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the investigation workflow, independent/hands-on evidence of Sift correctly identifying root causes, and integration depth with alerting.
